facts.fact: The article reports a study day on compliance with law n° 18-07, modified and completed by law n° 25-11; the article's date is an estimated month (mid-July 2026, published field 2026-07).
facts.system: Loi n° 18-07 du 10 juin 2018 (as amended by loi n° 25-11)

facts.fact: The article reports a study day at the national police college on the law's requirements for security work, and announces a unified guidance guide for administrative, security and judicial procedures; it reports no decision.
facts.system: Loi n° 18-07 du 10 juin 2018 (as amended by loi n° 25-11)

facts.fact: The article names Samir Bourehil as president of the ANPDP, present at the study day with the Justice and Interior ministers.
